title: Bells in the Barn
summary: A farmer keeps a notebook on holding a farm when the infected come. The last page is the problem.
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/PR4VXvw3Mqo (premise only: holding a farm against the infected)

beats.text: They follow sound. So when they walked onto my farm on day one, I made a plan.
Day two. I hung a bell on every fence post.
Day three. I rang the far bell, and they drifted off to the field.
Day four. Forty bells, all silent. I ate boiled eggs in the pickup.
Day five. The cows never panicked. They only stared at the barn.
Day six. At midnight every bell rang at once. Nothing had touched them.
The barn door was open. I had chained it shut myself.
A photo arrived from an unknown number. The barn, lit from inside.
Day seven. A bell rang in the barn, slowly, patiently.
The last line in my notebook is not my handwriting: Come feed us, Mary.
